enriched_activities.activity: Lying in bed doomscrolling YouTube videos and replying to WhatsApp messages on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back in bed with phone held in both hands above chest. Unlock phone with thumb. Open YouTube app and tap a video thumbnail. Scroll down the feed with right thumb. Tap the next video. Turn phone sideways. Tap the like button. Swipe up to the next video. Press the home button. Open WhatsApp. Tap the message from a friend. Type a reply with both thumbs. Send the message. Scroll the chat list. Open another chat. Type a reply. Put phone down on the mattress beside the pillow. Pick phone up again after a few seconds. Scroll through YouTube Shorts. Tap the play button. Place phone on the bedside table. Turn onto left side.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Reach out and place phone on the bedside table. Pull the blanket up to the chest. Turn onto right side. Close eyes. Adjust the pillow under the head with the right hand. Pull the blanket over the shoulder. Lie still with arms tucked under the pillow. Turn onto back. Breathe slowly. Turn onto left side. Pull the blanket up again. Remain lying down with eyes closed. Roll onto the back. Stretch both arms above the head. Turn onto the right side. Keep eyes closed. Remain still under the blanket. Roll onto the left side. Lie still until the alarm sound at 08:30.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed for the day (after Member 3 finishes their 07:20-08:00 bathroom slot)
enriched_activities.desc: Sit up on the edge of the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bedroom door. Open the door. Walk along the hallway to the bathroom. Push the bathroom door open. Step inside. Turn on the light switch. Turn on the tap. Cup both hands and splash water on the face. Pick up the facial cleanser. Squeeze cleanser into the left palm. Rub both palms together. Massage cleanser onto the face. Rinse the face with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel from the hook and pat the face dry. Hang the towel back. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush teeth for two minutes. Spit into the sink. Rinse the mouth with water from the cup. Turn off the tap. Put the toothbrush back in the holder. Walk back to Bedroom 2. Open the wardrobe. Pull out a top and trousers. Take off the pyjama top. Put on the top. Take off the pyjama bottoms. Put on the trousers. Pull socks onto both feet. Walk back to the bathroom. Turn off the light. Walk to the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle, making a pot of tea and eating breakfast at the kitchen counter (Member 3 has finished cooking breakfast; Member 4 is studying in Bedroom 4)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Open the upper cupboard. Take out the teapot and place it on the counter. Open the next cupboard. Take out a teacup and set it down. Open the drawer and take out a tea bag. Drop the tea bag into the teapot. Pick up the kettle from the base. Walk to the sink. Twist the tap open. Fill the kettle with water. Twist the tap closed. Walk back and place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle power switch down. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk and the breakfast container. Close the refrigerator door. Place both on the counter. Take a bowl from the cupboard. Pour cereal from the container into the bowl. Pour milk into the bowl. Pick up a spoon from the drawer. Kettle switches off; lift the kettle and pour hot water into the teapot. Replace the kettle on the base. Carry the bowl and spoon to the kitchen counter. Sit down on the stool. Lift the spoon and eat the cereal. Sip tea from the cup. Pick up the phone and check messages between bites. Finish the cereal. Stand up and carry the bowl to the sink. Push the stool back under the counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Daily stretching routine on the floor beside the bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the kitchen to Bedroom 2. Push the door open. Close the door behind. Walk to the space beside the bed. Place both hands on the floor. Lower onto the knees and then sit down on the floor mat. Extend both legs forward. Reach both hands toward the toes and bend the torso forward. Hold the position. Straighten the torso. Raise the right arm overhead and lean to the left. Return to the centre. Raise the left arm overhead and lean to the right. Return to the centre. Turn onto the stomach. Place both palms on the floor. Push up into a cobra position. Lower back down. Push hands and knees up into a downward dog position. Lower the hips and sit back. Stand up. Reach both arms overhead. Bend forward and touch the toes. Stand upright. Shake out both arms.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing breakfast dishes and wiping down shared kitchen benches
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from Bedroom 2 to the kitchen. Pick up the bowl and cup from the counter. Carry them to the sink. Place them in the sink basin. Twist the tap open. Pick up the sponge. Squeeze dish soap onto the sponge. Scrub the bowl inside and out. Rinse the bowl under the running water. Place the bowl in the dish rack. Scrub the cup and the teapot. Rinse them and place them in the rack. Scrub the spoon. Rinse it. Place it in the rack. Turn off the tap. Pick up the cloth from the counter. Wipe the counter surface with the cloth. Rinse the cloth under the tap. Wring the cloth out. Hang the cloth on the hook. Push the stool back against the counter. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending online design studio class on the computer and monitor, taking notes and sketching concepts
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 2. Sit down on the desk chair. Press the computer power button. Press the monitor power button. Move the mouse and click the video call link in the browser. Turn on the desk lamp. Adjust the webcam angle. Put on the headset. Unmute the microphone when called on. Say hello to the tutor and classmates. Type notes into the document with both hands on the keyboard. Pick up the pencil. Sketch a layout concept in the sketchbook beside the keyboard. Erase part of the sketch. Draw again. Take a screenshot of the shared screen. Save the file. Mute the microphone. Stand up and stretch the arms. Sit back down. Open a second browser tab and read the class brief. Type more notes. Zoom in on the shared presentation. Switch to the notebook and write down the reading list. Sip water from the bottle on the desk. Adjust the chair height. Straighten the posture. Type the final notes of the class. Click the leave meeting button at 12:00.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a lunch that fits her medical dietary restriction using the induction cooker, sharing the kitchen with Member 1 who is reheating her own lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the desk chair. Walk out of Bedroom 2 to the kitchen. Greet Member 1 with 'Hi, I'll use the induction cooker now.' Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables, the protein pack and a container of rice. Close the refrigerator door. Place the ingredients on the counter. Take the cutting board from the shelf. Pick up the knife from the block. Wash the vegetables under the tap. Turn the tap off. Chop the vegetables into pieces on the cutting board. Slide the chopped vegetables into a bowl. Place the frying pan on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker power button. Pour oil into the pan. Add the chopped vegetables with the spatula. Stir the vegetables. Add the protein pack. Stir again. Sprinkle salt from the shaker. Add the cooked rice. Stir everything together. Press the power button to switch off the induction cooker. Spoon the food onto a plate. Move the plate to the counter beside Member 1's plate. Pick up the used pan and cutting board and place them in the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch while listening to a design podcast on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Sit down on the stool at the kitchen counter. Pick up the phone from the counter. Unlock the screen with the thumb. Open the podcast app. Tap the design podcast episode. Press play. Place the phone on the counter beside the plate. Pick up the fork. Lift the fork to the mouth. Chew and swallow. Take another bite. Put the fork down. Pick up the water glass and sip. Put the glass down. Pick up the fork again and continue eating. Turn the phone volume up with the side button. Pick up the phone and skip forward thirty seconds. Put the phone back on the counter. Finish the food on the plate. Push the plate forward. Pick up the phone and pause the podcast. Stand up from the stool. Carry the plate to the sink. Nod to Member 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on freelance creative briefs on the computer, editing files and emailing drafts to clients
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the kitchen to Bedroom 2. Sit down on the desk chair. Wake the computer by moving the mouse. Open the design software file for the client brief. Zoom into the artwork with the scroll wheel. Select the text tool and type the client's name. Change the font size in the panel. Drag the logo element to the centre of the canvas. Resize the logo with the corner handles. Pick up the graphics tablet pen and draw a new shape. Erase part of the shape. Recolour the shape using the colour picker. Apply a stroke to the shape. Save the file with Ctrl+S. Export the file as a PDF. Open the email client. Click compose. Type the client's email address in the To field. Type a subject line. Attach the exported PDF. Type a short body message. Click send. Open the next client brief document and read it. Create a new canvas. Drag a background image into the canvas. Save the new file. Stretch both arms overhead. Roll the neck. Continue editing the second file. Export the second draft and email it out.

enriched_activities.activity: Brewing another cup of tea and having a light snack
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the desk chair. Walk from Bedroom 2 to the kitchen. Open the cupboard and take out a cup. Place the cup on the counter. Pick up the kettle and walk to the sink. Twist the tap open and fill the kettle. Twist the tap closed. Return the kettle to its base. Press the kettle switch down. Open the cupboard and take out the biscuit packet. Open the packet and take out two biscuits. Place them on a small plate. Open the tea tin and take out a tea bag. Drop the tea bag into the cup. Wait for the kettle to switch off. Lift the kettle and pour water into the cup. Replace the kettle on the base. Dip the tea bag with a spoon. Take out the tea bag and drop it in the bin. Add a splash of milk from the refrigerator. Carry the cup and plate to the kitchen counter. Sit down on the stool. Eat the biscuits and sip the tea. Finish and carry the cup and plate to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing coursework and assignment writing on the computer at her desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the kitchen to Bedroom 2. Sit down on the desk chair. Turn on the desk lamp. Wake the computer. Open the assignment document from the desktop folder. Scroll to the section left unfinished. Place both hands on the keyboard and type the next paragraph. Stop and read the paragraph. Highlight a sentence with the mouse. Delete the sentence and retype it. Open the referencing guide in a browser tab. Copy a citation. Paste the citation into the reference list. Underline the source title. Adjust the line spacing from the format menu. Save the document with Ctrl+S. Stand up and refill the water bottle from the bathroom tap. Return to the desk and sit down. Open the reading PDF and scroll through pages. Copy a quotation and paste it into the document. Type analysis of the quotation. Check the word count in the status bar. Read the full draft from the beginning. Correct two spelling errors with the keyboard. Save the file again. Close the reading PDF. Sit back in the chair and rotate both wrists.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing a guided stretch and mobility session together with Member 1, then resting with the fan on
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the desk chair. Walk out of Bedroom 2 to the Living Room. Say to Member 1 'Ready for the stretching session?' Stand beside the sofa and face the TV. Pick up the remote and press the power button. Open the guided stretch video on the phone and mirror it to the TV. Place the phone on the coffee table. Spread the yoga mat on the floor. Sit down on the mat. Extend the legs and reach for the toes. Hold the position. Straighten up. Raise both arms overhead. Lean to the right side. Return and lean to the left side. Lie back on the mat and draw the right knee to the chest. Switch to the left knee. Turn onto the side and do the hip opener. Roll onto the back and do the shoulder bridge. Lie flat and breathe. Sit up. Stand and roll up the mat. Pick up the remote and press the fan power button. Sit on the sofa beside Member 1. Stretch the legs out. Press the fan speed button once. Rest against the sofa back.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner from scratch with ingredients suitable for her dietary restriction, sharing the kitchen with Member 1 and Member 3 who are also cooking
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the sofa. Walk from the Living Room to the kitchen. Say to Member 1 and Member 3 'I'll use the induction cooker for dinner.' Open the refrigerator door and take out the vegetables, the meat substitute and the sauce bottle. Close the refrigerator door. Place everything on the counter. Take the cutting board and knife from the shelf. Wash the vegetables under the tap. Turn off the tap. Chop the vegetables into even pieces. Slide them into a bowl. Place the pot on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker power button. Pour oil into the pot. Add the chopped onion with the spatula. Stir the onion until it turns clear. Add the meat substitute. Stir with the spatula. Pour the sauce over the mixture. Add the remaining vegetables. Stir again. Put the lid on the pot. Open the rice cooker lid and check the rice. Close the lid. Take the plates from the cupboard and set three on the counter. Stir the pot again. Press the power button to switch the induction cooker off. Spoon the food onto the plates. Carry the plates to the counter. Wipe the counter area with the cloth. Place the used pots in the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner together with Member 1 and Member 3
enriched_activities.desc: Pull the stool up to the kitchen counter. Sit down with Member 1 and Member 3. Pick up the fork with the right hand. Lift the fork to the mouth and eat the first bite. Say to Member 3 'How did the supervision meeting go?' Chew and listen to the reply. Take another bite. Pick up the water glass and sip. Put the glass down. Continue eating. Pick up the phone and check a message. Put the phone face down on the counter. Take another bite of the vegetables. Cut a piece with the side of the fork. Add sauce from the small dish. Eat the remaining food on the plate. Push the plate forward. Pick up the plate with both hands. Stand up and carry the plate to the sink. Return to the stool and finish the water in the glass. Stand up. Push the stool in. Wait for Member 1 and Member 3 to finish eating.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes, wiping benches and taking out kitchen rubbish together with Member 1 and Member 3
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the plates and stack them beside the sink. Pick up the cups and place them in the sink. Twist the tap open. Squeeze dish soap onto the sponge. Scrub the plates one by one. Rinse each plate under the running water. Place the plates in the dish rack. Scrub the pots and pans. Rinse them and set them in the rack. Scrub the cutlery and rinse it. Turn off the tap. Pick up the cloth and wipe the kitchen counters. Wipe the stovetop surface. Rinse the cloth under the tap. Wring it and hang it on the hook. Pull the bin liner out of the bin. Tie the top of the liner with both hands. Carry the bag to the front door. Open the door and place the bag in the outside bin. Close the door. Walk back to the kitchen. Say 'Done' to Member 1 and Member 3.

enriched_activities.activity: Joining a big-group virtual hangout with friends over video call together with Member 3, chatting and sharing screens
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the kitchen to the Living Room with Member 3. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the phone. Unlock it and open the video call app. Tap the join meeting link. Adjust the phone against the cushion so the camera faces the face. Turn on the microphone. Say hello to the friends on the call. Wave at the screen. Listen to a friend's update. Laugh and reply to the group. Pick up the laptop and open the file to share. Press the share screen button. Walk through the design slides on the call. Stop sharing the screen. Put the laptop on the coffee table. Turn to Member 3 and comment on the group chat. Pick up the phone again and unmute. Reply to a friend's question. Turn on the fan with the remote. Sit back on the sofa. Adjust the phone angle. Tap the chat box and type a message. Send a reaction emoji. Continue talking with the group. Wave goodbye and press the leave button at 21:15.

enriched_activities.activity: Sorting sketchbooks and art supplies at her desk and browsing art supply sales online
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the sofa. Walk from the Living Room to Bedroom 2. Slide the sketchbooks on the desk into a single stack. Cap the loose markers and drop them into the pen holder. Pick up the eraser and put it in the drawer. Open the drawer and place the spare pencils inside. Close the drawer. Sit down on the desk chair. Wake the computer. Open the browser and type 'art supply sale' in the search bar. Press Enter. Scroll through the results. Click a listing and open the product page. Add two marker sets to the online cart. Open the cart and check the total. Save the cart and close the tab. Stand up. Pick up the phone and the towel. Walk to the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering, completing her night hygiene routine and running a load of laundry in the washing machine (after Member 4's 21:00-21:30 evening shower, so Member 1 can use the bathroom from 22:45)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the light. Place the phone on the shelf. Turn on the water heater switch. Twist the shower tap open. Step into the shower cubicle. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Rub it into the scalp. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap and lather the body. Rinse off. Twist the shower tap closed. Step out and pick up the towel. Dry the hair and body. Wrap the towel around. Pick up the second towel and wipe the shower floor. Hang the towels on the rail. Open the cabinet and take out the laundry hamper contents. Open the washing machine lid. Load the clothes into the drum. Add detergent from the box into the drawer. Close the lid. Press the start button. Pick up the toothbrush and squeeze toothpaste onto it. Brush teeth. Rinse the mouth. Wash the face with cleanser and rinse. Apply moisturiser with both hands. Hang the damp towel on the hook. Pick up the phone. Turn off the light. Open the door and step out into the hallway.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a final herbal tea and rinsing her mug
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the bathroom to the kitchen. Open the cupboard and take out a mug. Place it on the counter. Pick up the kettle and fill it at the sink. Twist the tap closed. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch down. Open the tin and take out a herbal tea bag. Drop it into the mug. Wait for the kettle to switch off. Lift the kettle and pour water into the mug. Replace the kettle on the base. Carry the mug to the counter and sit on the stool. Sip the tea. Stand up. Carry the mug to the sink. Rinse the mug under the tap. Turn off the tap. Place the mug upside down in the dish rack. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: In bed half-watching YouTube videos and answering WhatsApp messages while drifting off to sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the kitchen to Bedroom 2. Push the door open. Close the door. Take off the slippers and place them beside the bed. Pull back the blanket. Sit on the edge of the bed. Lie down on the right side. Pull the blanket up to the chest. Pick up the phone from the bedside table. Unlock the screen. Open YouTube and tap a video. Watch with the phone held in the left hand. Scroll to the next video. Press the home button. Open WhatsApp. Tap the unread chat. Type a reply with the right thumb. Send it. Open the next chat and type another reply. Send it. Put the phone face down on the bedside table. Turn onto the left side. Pick the phone up again and scroll one more video. Press the power button to lock the screen. Place the phone back on the bedside table. Pull the blanket over the shoulder. Close eyes.
